regenerationTest.conclusion: No new rule required. Eighteenth consecutive section to need none. The useful result is negative: a section where the baseline is wrong twice over and the shipped text is right, so the re-render's output is no change. Fourteen sections were re-rendered before R-LEDGER-WINS existed, and a pass without it would have restored a superseded subtitle and reinstated a production note that CTD-0105 records as breaking audio word timing.
